title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
每天早上，小红狼都要给外婆送吃的东西，
有醋泡小黄瓜，还有香辣熟肉酱。
page_text_en:
Every morning, Little Red Wolf has to bring food to Grandma,
including pickled cucumbers and spicy cooked meat sauce.
summary_zh: 小红狼每天早上都要给外婆送食物，包括醋泡小黄瓜和香辣熟肉酱，画面中它正走在通往外婆家的蜿蜒小路上。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小红狼一点儿都不怕狼。
她在树林里玩耍，才不担心有没有狼呢。
page_text_en:
Little Red Wolf isn't afraid of wolves at all.
She plays in the woods and doesn't worry at all about whether there are wolves or not.
summary_zh: 小红狼在橙黄色的树林里玩耍，她一点也不害怕狼，画面中她背着小包，旁边有一只小虫子，背景是光秃的树木和温暖的天空。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh: 不过，说到狼，我们就看到了狼尾巴。
page_text_en: But, speaking of wolves, we saw a wolf's tail.
summary_zh: 小红狼在橙红色的树林中行走，突然发现远处有一条黑色的狼尾巴，画面营造出一种紧张又好奇的氛围。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小红狼准备采些花儿送给外婆。
小黑狼一点点地走近她，蹑手蹑脚的。
page_text_en:
Little Red Wolf was preparing to pick some flowers to give to her grandmother.
Little Black Wolf crept closer to her, quietly and cautiously.
summary_zh: 小红狼在橙红色的树林里准备采花送给外婆，小黑狼正悄悄地、蹑手蹑脚地靠近她。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
“这儿有一朵给你的花儿——一朵‘金鱼草’。”
小黑狼说，“我能够成为你的小狼吗？”
page_text_en:
"Here is a flower for you—a 'snapdragon.'"
Little Black Wolf said, "Can I become your little wolf?"
summary_zh: 小黑狼向小红狼递上一朵金鱼草，并询问是否能成为她的小狼，画面中两只小狼在橙红色的树林里相对而立。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小黑狼扮成小绵羊。
小红狼在后面追着他。
他们尽情地玩狼捉羊的游戏。
page_text_en:
The little black wolf pretends to be a little sheep.
The little red wolf chases after him.
They play the game of wolf catching sheep with all their hearts.
summary_zh: 小黑狼扮成小绵羊，小红狼在后面追他，两人在橙红色的树林里开心地玩狼捉羊的游戏。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小红狼和小黑狼好饿好饿，饿得就像只狼。
他们大口大口地吃着醋泡小黄瓜和香辣熟肉酱，
给外婆的东西都让他们吃光了。
page_text_en:
Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf were so hungry, so hungry, they felt like real wolves.
They ate the pickled cucumbers and spicy meat sauce big mouthfuls after big mouthfuls.
They ate up all the food meant for Grandma.
summary_zh: 小红狼和小黑狼在橙红色的田野上，大口吃着原本要带给外婆的食物，显得非常饥饿。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
小红狼和小黑狼远远望见一群伐木工，
他们赶紧跑开了。
如果伐木工追上他们，那是非常可怕的事情。
page_text_en:
Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf saw a group of lumberjacks in the distance,
they quickly ran away.
If the lumberjacks caught up with them, it would be a very scary thing.
summary_zh: 小红狼和小黑狼在橙红色的田野上奔跑，因为他们远远望见了一群伐木工，感到害怕而逃开。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
夜晚降临了。天空中升起一轮圆圆的月亮。
小红狼和小黑狼在黑暗中低吼。
page_text_en:
Night fell. A round, round moon rose in the sky.
Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf howled in the darkness.
summary_zh: 夜晚降临，一轮圆月升起，小红狼和小黑狼在橙色的田野上对着月亮低吼。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
黄昏时分，小黑狼脱掉帽子，
瞧，他既不是狼，也不是传说中的狼人。
他是一个机灵的小男孩。
page_text_en:
At dusk, Little Black Wolf takes off his hat,
Look, he is neither a wolf nor the werewolf from legend.
He is a clever little boy.
summary_zh: 黄昏时分，小黑狼脱下帽子，揭示他其实是一个机灵的小男孩，而非真正的狼或狼人。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
黄昏时分，小红狼也脱掉帽子，
瞧，她既不是狼，也不是传说中的狼人。
她是一个漂亮的小女孩。
page_text_en:
At dusk, Little Red Wolf takes off her hat,
Look, she is neither a wolf nor a werewolf from legend.
She is a lovely little girl.
summary_zh: 黄昏时分，小红狼脱下帽子，揭示她其实是一个小女孩，而非真正的狼或狼人。

title_en: Little Red Wolf and Little Black Wolf
source_file: 小红狼和小黑狼(3-5 岁) .ppt
page_text_ocr_zh:
现在，赶快去外婆家吧。
要是真的来了一只狼，一口就把我们吃掉了！
page_text_en:
Now, let's hurry to Grandma's house.
If a real wolf comes, it will eat us up in one bite!
summary_zh: 小红狼和小黑狼在橙红色的田野上沿着小路走向远处的外婆家，担心真狼会吃掉他们。
